name: jump-launch
prompt: A quick springy platformer jump: soft leather-and-cloth push-off whoosh with a tiny clockwork ratchet click at the end, dry and close-miked.

name: land-thud
prompt: A short dull body landing thud on a wooden platform, low muted impact with a faint boot scuff, no reverb tail.

name: step-tick
prompt: A single light footstep tap on hollow wood with a faint clockwork tick, very short and quiet, dry studio recording.

name: gear-collect
prompt: A bright metallic clink of a small brass gear being picked up, two quick ringing metal ticks with a short shimmer decay.

name: death-crunch
prompt: A sudden mechanical trap snap: sharp metal clank followed by a brief crunching grind of gears and a low thump, cartoonish not gory.

name: checkpoint-chime
prompt: Two soft ascending brass bell chimes with a gentle clockwork winding sound underneath, warm and reassuring.

name: spring-boing
prompt: A cartoon coil spring boing, pitch rising upward as it launches, metallic and bouncy with a quick decay.

name: win-fanfare
prompt: A short triumphant clockwork fanfare: four bright ascending bell notes with spinning ratchet clicks and a final warm chime.

name: fail-drop
prompt: A descending disappointed slide whistle falling in pitch ending in a soft wooden clunk, lighthearted game-over sting.

name: invalid-buzz
prompt: A very short low mechanical buzz of a stuck gear refusing to turn, muted and brief, like a denied button press.

name: reveal-shimmer
prompt: A magical descending shimmer of small glass chimes as a hidden object sparkles into view, airy and high-pitched.

name: ui-click
prompt: A single crisp UI button click, like a small wooden toggle switch snapping, extremely short and dry.

name: countdown-beep
prompt: A single clean mid-pitched electronic metronome beep for a countdown tick, short with a soft attack.

name: go-horn
prompt: A short bright starting horn blast, one high clear note like a tiny brass toy trumpet signaling go.

name: achievement-chime
prompt: A cheerful three-note rising glockenspiel chime with a sparkle tail, like unlocking a badge in a puzzle game.
